notes.title: Virtual Exhibition on Steam Deck
notes.content:
I can confirm that the Virtual Exhibition runs natively on the Steam Deck and performs well.

The books can also be browsed via touch function!

I'm sorry that I haven't published an update for the Virtual Exhibition for a while. As I've mentioned several times, I've been working on this project alone and had to work on my own photographic projects in the recent months.

There will be updates for the Virtual Exhibition and then with a higher frequency of new content. I just have to finish the technology behind it, which is difficult for me as a non-programmer.

See you then!

-Kersten

notes.title: More Photographers and VR
notes.content:
Hello and happy new year 2021!

I will need some time for the upcoming update, which will include two more photographers and an implementation for VR devices. My studies and other projects have to be moved forward as well and so I ask for your understanding. 

In addition, I will probably create a closed beta for the VR mode, so that I can understand the performance on different systems with various devices and bring a product to the public that is as bug-free as possible. 

[previewyoutube=2o75YV5JtK0;full][/previewyoutube]

I would also like to remind you not to be afraid to send me bug reports. 

See you!

[i]-Kersten[/i]

notes.title: Update Beta 0.2.0
notes.content:
This is my first big update with new features and content for the Virtual Exhibition. With this update I also want to demonstrate what you can expect from this application. My goal is to add new content and functions from time to time. I also don't want to stress myself with announcements, which may not be kept. For this reason, updates are published at irregular intervals and may be very sudden.

In this update I integrated several objects you can interact with. Mainly two books that are exact replicas of the books in the real world. But there are also some objects you might want to take with you. If you approach a book, it will be highlighted as soon as you are in range to interact with it. To interact you can use [b]E[/b] or [b]Left Mouse[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787921/3c699aa5e2de0e5fa6485fffaa388be5b7eb63dc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787921/87d8c663136f3cdd220dc3d86c244b3216d8db5b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787921/b5f6192ec3a7efeea9d015111f6c4d4be0c3816d.jpg[/img]

Besides interaction and books, new photographers were added to the exhibition. These are Fabian Reiche and Kersten Glaser (me). Adding my own exhibition gave me the opportunity to let my creativity run free, to go beyond the limits of what is possible in reality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787921/680cd6dd91798a023277224c3d09496017cd266b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787921/746d88269b6ee39e382e9fe38f659ff612c42745.jpg[/img]

However, I cannot say often enough how positively surprised I am about the small community that has already formed. You inspire me to keep developing. Thanks to all of you! 

I hope you enjoy this update! 

[i]-Kersten[/i]


[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Features[/h3][list]
[*] Interaction
[*] Readable books[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3][list]
[*] Photographer Fabian Reiche  
[*] Photographer Kersten Glaser + book
[*] Added the book of Robert Krenciszek to the exhibition
[*] QR-Codes[/list] 

[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the light
[*] Adjusted some sound effects
[*] Adjusted glass effects[/list]

[h3]Linux Support Cancelled[/h3]
I cancel the support for Linux (for now) because I don't have the necessary skills. Maybe in the future I'll find someone to do that for me, or I'll get better. I hope you can understand that. I'm very sorry.
